theme.title: The Numbers Game
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did Seattle win on its 1979 title run?
questions.note: 52–30, then Seattle beat Washington in a Finals rematch for its only championship.

funFacts.text: Coach Lenny Wilkens guided the Seattle team from the Kingdome sidelines.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Head coach | Lenny Wilkens

funFacts.text: Finals MVP Dennis Johnson also made the All-Defensive First Team.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Dennis Johnson, NBA All-Defensive First Team

funFacts.text: Seattle beat Washington in the Finals after losing to the Bullets the previous year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Sonics would go on to avenge their NBA Finals loss and defeat the Bullets

questions.prompt: Michael Jordan averaged 41.0 points in the 1993 Finals. How many did he score in Game 4 against Phoenix?
questions.note: Fourteen above his Finals-record 41.0 average, and Chicago moved one win from the title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In Game 4, Michael Jordan was unstoppable, scoring 55 points at Chicago Stadium

funFacts.text: Phoenix arrived with 62 wins and the regular-season MVP, Charles Barkley.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: winners of 62 games and led by regular season MVP Charles Barkley

funFacts.text: Two games later, John Paxson's three with 3.9 seconds left put Chicago ahead 99–98.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Paxson then made a three pointer with 3.9 seconds left, giving the Bulls a 99–98 lead.

funFacts.text: Chicago became the first team since the 1960s Celtics to win three straight titles.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Bulls became the first team since the Boston Celtics of the 1960s to win three consecutive championship titles

questions.prompt: Portland, the Lakers and Denver all won playoff blowouts. By how many points did Chicago beat Utah in Game 3 of the 1998 Finals?
questions.note: The largest margin in NBA Finals history.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In a 96–54 loss, the Jazz set the record for the 42-point loss in Finals history

funFacts.text: Every player on Chicago's roster scored at least once in the rout.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Every player on the Bulls roster scored at least once

funFacts.text: Utah had beaten Chicago in both regular-season meetings that year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Jazz had won both regular season meetings with the Bulls

funFacts.text: The Jazz reached the Finals by sweeping the Lakers in the West finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Jazz uneventfully swept the Los Angeles Lakers

questions.prompt: LeBron James took 38 shots in Game 1 of the 2015 Finals. In his 100-point game, how many shots did Wilt Chamberlain take?
questions.note: 63 shots and 36 makes, both NBA records, plus 28 free throws.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Playing all 48 minutes of the game, Chamberlain set NBA records for field goals attempted (63) and made (36)

funFacts.text: The game was not televised, and no video footage of it has been recovered.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The game was not televised, and no video footage of the game has been recovered

funFacts.text: New York began intentionally fouling other Warriors to prevent Wilt from getting the ball in the fourth quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Knicks began fouling other players to keep the ball away from Chamberlain

funFacts.text: Wilt set a free-throw record despite his reputation as an unreliable shooter from the line.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Chamberlain set five other league records that game, including most free throws made

questions.prompt: Reggie Miller and James Harden also topped 50 as guards. How many points did Steph Curry score at Madison Square Garden in February 2013?
questions.context: Stephen Curry · Warriors at Knicks · February 2013
questions.note: Not enough: the Knicks won anyway, 109–105.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On February 27, 2013, Stephen Curry scored 54 points but his Warriors lost to the Knicks, 109–105.

funFacts.text: He made a franchise-record eleven three-pointers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: making a Warriors franchise-record 11 three-pointers on 11 of 13 shooting from 3-point range

funFacts.text: The game is cited as Curry's breakthrough performance.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The game is cited as the "breakthrough" performance and one of the most notable games in Curry's career.

funFacts.text: That season he set the single-season record with 272 threes, passing Ray Allen.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He set a new NBA single-season three-point record with 272 three-pointers, eclipsing the previous mark set by Ray Allen
